gate_1_mag_manip_per_system.tolerance: 10 eps64 / c, c the worst cancellation at the archive's own 64 points, per system; each tolerance below 1e-9
gate_1_mag_manip_per_system.predicted: every system within its tolerance, the miss eps64 / c to within a factor of three: CardioMag about 9e-16, Navion_2 about 3e-14, OctoMag about 2e-12 (c at the new points within a factor of two of the 0.2 points'); the host helper and the node agree with each other to the same order
